name: Mechs vs Kaiju's Ragdoll | [DRILL UPDATE]
desc:
EARLY RELEASE: this game is still being built - expect some bugs and new updates often!

CODES (ROBUX SHOP): like + favorite + join our group to use them!
DRILL, 500KVISITS, 1KACTIVE, LUCKYPACKS, RELEASE, UPDATE, BUGS, BUGFIX, SORRYFORBUGS, NEXT

Kaiju are coming out of the sea. Stop them!

Pilot a giant ragdoll mech and fight monster waves with real physics. Punch, grab, throw and smash kaiju through buildings - the whole city breaks apart.

MECHS
- Cipsy Dagger: chain sword finishers, plasma beam, rocket elbows
- Coyote Tangle: twin shoulder cannons, EnergyCaster blast, throwdown
- Black Alpha: hydraulic fists, piston grab, hydraulic dropkick
- Red Tsunami: saw claws, Thundercloud, gut saw
- Bravo Guardian: whip snare, electric whip
- Plus Titan, Scorpion, Agility, Ripper, Mace and more

Squad up with friends - every match gets its own server. Earn scrap, open mech packs and unlock wave checkpoints. Works on PC, phone and console.

Made by Jadyboy467 & EZMON107.

llm.loop: pilot a ragdoll mech -> fight waves of kaiju with physics punches/grabs/throws in a destructible city -> earn scrap -> open mech packs and unlock wave checkpoints
llm.objectives: stop kaiju waves, reach later wave checkpoints, unlock more mechs
llm.progression: mech roster from packs, scrap, wave checkpoints
llm.instructions: pilot a giant ragdoll mech, punch/grab/throw kaiju through buildings, squad up with friends, earn scrap and open mech packs; redeem codes in the Robux shop
unique: physics-driven ragdoll mech vs kaiju brawling with full city destruction
Pacific Rim-style named mechs with distinct move sets
monetization_signals: Robux packs (in-game currency) and giftable packs
